title: Topological Signal Processing With Unoriented Operators
abstract: arXiv:2609.25310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topological signal processing (TSP) processes signals on simplicial complexes with oriented boundary operators, which is the natural choice for flow signals or when the topological invariants play a role for the task at hand. However, many higher-order signals carry no orientation, and applying oriented operators to them is not well-defined since it introduces an arbitrary choice of simplex orientation. We study an unoriented TSP (UTSP) framework that replaces oriented boundaries with unoriented incidence matrices. First, we show that unoriented incidence and Laplacian matrices between arbitrary simplicial levels admit graph-like spectral properties. Second, since dropping orientation removes the Hodge decomposition, we introduce an unoriented counterpart, termed interaction-order decomposition, which quantifies how much of a higher-order signal is explained by aggregating lower-order signals. translated_title: 基于无向算子的拓扑信号处理
translated_abstract: 拓扑信号处理（TSP）使用有向边界算子在单纯复形上处理信号，这对于流信号或在当前任务中拓扑不变量发挥作用的情形是自然的选择。然而，许多高阶信号本身不带方向性，对其应用有向算子并无良好定义，因为这会引入对单纯形方向的任意选择。我们研究了一种无向拓扑信号处理（UTSP）框架，用无向关联矩阵取代有向边界。首先，我们证明了任意单纯层级之间的无向关联矩阵和拉普拉斯矩阵具有类似图的谱性质。其次，由于去掉方向性会使霍奇分解不再适用，我们引入了一种无向的对应物，称为交互阶分解，它量化了高阶信号中有多少可以通过聚合低阶信号来解释。第三，我们利用这种分解来推导……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出无向拓扑信号处理（UTSP）框架，用无向关联矩阵取代有向边界算子，证明了任意单纯层级间的类图谱性质，并引入交互阶分解替代霍奇分解，以量化高阶信号被低阶信号聚合所解释的程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unoriented topological signal processing (UTSP) framework that replaces oriented boundaries with unoriented incidence matrices, shows their graph-like spectral properties between arbitrary simplicial levels, and introduces an interaction-order decomposition to quantify how much of a higher-order signal is explained by aggregating lower-order signals.
